description: MainActivity class for an Android app that manages Bluetooth support, enabling Bluetooth, checking for Bluetooth advertising support, and setting up UI fragments.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An activity that manages Bluetooth initialization, checks device support, and sets up UI fragments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth support, checks device capabilities, and loads fragments if supported.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result of Bluetooth enable request, proceeds if Bluetooth is enabled, otherwise exits.

methods.name: setupFragments
methods.description: Sets up and replaces UI fragments for scanning and advertising Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: showErrorText
methods.description: Displays an error message in the UI.
